# Spizzico Italian Kitchen

> > Spizzico Italian Kitchen is an Italian restaurant in the Broadneck Peninsula area offering authentic Italian cuisine, catering services, and community involvement with local Broadneck schools.

Spizzico serves traditional Italian dishes including pizza, pasta, and antipasto while actively supporting the Broadneck community through fundraisers and partnerships with St. Margaret's Day School, Broadneck High School, and Broadneck Elementary. The restaurant also provides catering for weddings, corporate events, and hosts community fundraising events.

## Key Topics

## Italian Cooking Guides & Recipes

- [How to Make Your Favorite Sauces at Home](https://spizzicorestaurant.com/how-to-make-your-favorite-sauces-at-home): Homemade Italian sauce recipes: marinara, alfredo, and pesto guides
- [The Art of Antipasto: Crafting Flavorful Italian Starters](https://spizzicorestaurant.com/the-art-of-antipasto): Antipasto guide with prosciutto, wine pairings, and platter tips
- [Beyond Tomato Sauce: Alternative Pizza and Pasta Sauces to Try](https://spizzicorestaurant.com/tomato-sauce-alternatives): Alternative sauces: pesto, alfredo, garlic oil, and béchamel options
- [6 Fresh Herbs Commonly Used in Italian Cuisine](https://spizzicorestaurant.com/fresh-herbs-used-in-italian-cuisine): Essential Italian herbs: basil, rosemary, parsley for authentic dishes
- [Cooking with Olive Oil: 4 Things to Know](https://spizzicorestaurant.com/cooking-with-olive-oil-4-things-to-know): Essential tips for cooking with olive oil in Italian cuisine
- [The Tomato Lovers' Guide to Every Locally Used Type of Tomato](https://spizzicorestaurant.com/the-tomato-lovers-type-of-tomato): Guide to tomato varieties: Roma, Beefsteak, Early Girl, Big Boy types
